subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should WebChat send-shortcut behavior be owned by scoped Control UI settings, gateway/openclaw.json config, both surfaces, or left unchanged?
rationale: Current main has no send-shortcut setting and the linked PR adds persisted behavior, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and existing chat preferences already use scoped UI settings.

options.title: Use Scoped Control UI Preference
options.body: Add the shortcut mode to the existing scoped UiSettings path, keep Enter-to-send as default, and avoid a new gateway config key unless operators need fleet control.

options.title: Add Gateway Config Too
options.body: Expose an explicit gateway/openclaw.json option only if maintainers want operator-managed defaults and are willing to update schema, docs, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Reject the feature for now and close the linked PR plus duplicates with rationale, leaving plain Enter-to-send as the only supported composer behavior.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped Control UI Preference
recommendation.body: Add the shortcut mode to the existing scoped UiSettings path, keep Enter-to-send as default, and avoid a new gateway config key unless operators need fleet control.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the open implementation candidate and have adjacent review history on the composer/IME path.
